text:
drew_sales: Handoff: Cardinal Clinics pilot signed (60d). PO received. Go-live: 2025-06-20. They need SAML SSO, BAA, private control plane in us-east-1 preferred, and Splunk audit forwarding. Expected traffic ~18k tokens/day, peak ~10 concurrent sessions. Primary contact: claire@cardinal.clinic. Docs: https://share.cardinal/pilot-pack

anya_cs: I'll lead onboarding. Quick questions: 1) private plane vs dedicated pool — which is required for PHI? 2) Do they want 12mo log retention?

drew_sales: They want private control plane for PHI isolation. 12mo retention requested but flexible if add-on cost needed. No model training.

leo_support: Opening infra ticket. Need SAML metadata (IdP XML), customer VPC CIDR for peering, Splunk HEC endpoint + token, and scanned BAA. Provision ETA: 3 biz days after artifacts.

mira_eng: Perf note: to meet p99 <300ms during peaks we should warm a small dedicated pool in the 8am-4pm window. Need avg tokens/session and sample prompts for eval.
drew_sales: Avg tokens/session ~650. Peak window 8am-2pm ET.

anya_cs: Action owners: CS=anya_cs (onboard + kickoff), Support=leo_support (infra), Eng=mira_eng (sizing + canary), Security=sam_security (BAA + compliance), Sales=drew_sales (contract follow-ups).

sam_security: I'll review BAA and any security questionnaire. HSM-backed key storage required; estimate +3 business days for HSM provisioning. Also confirm retention and Splunk ingest policy.

kickoff-bot: ticket CS-4201 created by leo_support - infra.provision.privateplane

leo_support: Scheduling tech kickoff Thu 2025-06-05 11:00am ET (placeholder). @anya_cs please confirm.

anya_cs: Confirmed. Sending onboarding checklist to customer today. Will capture eval prompt set in kickoff and own the weekly health sync.

mira_eng: Plan: run perf sims on their eval prompts and test q8 quant. If key clinical prompts drop >2% accuracy we'll recommend non-quant for canary. Canary plan suggestion: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h steps with rollback thresholds.

drew_sales: Renewal risk: medium. Pilot is the gate for enterprise contract; main risks are delays in BAA/HSM and any sustained latency incidents. Sales will flag immediately if customer signals concern.

anya_cs: I'll add a health flag to the tracker and set weekly syncs (Wednesdays). Escalation: if infra or security blockers exceed 6 business days escalate to Head of CS and CRO. Closing loop: I'll post update after kickoff with owners and due dates.
